verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official, globally installable CLI (`npm install -g @hubspot/cli && hs init`) with an authorize-and-build flow. Its CLI-based Developer MCP server lets agentic development tools drive the CLI to scaffold and manage projects, which ties it directly to AI-native workflows. missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers CRM data operations beyond developer-platform project scaffolding, a documented command reference or machine-readable output modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
